final: WITH department_counts AS (SELECT major.department, COUNT(*) AS department_count FROM member JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY major.department), totals AS (SELECT SUM(department_count) AS total_count FROM department_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(1.0 * department_count / total_count) AS avg_share FROM department_counts JOIN totals ON total_count IS NOT NULL) SELECT d.department, d.department_count, 1.0 * d.department_count / t.total_count AS share, 1.0 * d.department_count / t.total_count - a.avg_share AS share_minus_average FROM department_counts AS d JOIN totals AS t ON t.total_count IS NOT NULL JOIN average_share AS a ON a.avg_share IS NOT NULL WHERE 1.0 * d.department_count / t.total_count > a.avg_share
